name: Cookies Addons Paragraphs
description: COOKiES add-on that withholds Paragraphs entities (chosen by paragraph ID) behind cookie consent, showing a placeholder overlay and AJAX-loading the paragraph once the matching cookies service is accepted.
project_description: Submodule of Cookies Addons. Blocks Paragraphs entities (identified by paragraph ID) until the visitor consents to a configured COOKiES service, then loads the paragraph via AJAX. Requires the Paragraphs module. Configure at /admin/config/system/cookies-addons-paragraphs.
